## Behavior

Add bounded live observation and coefficient steering to `llm_generate(async = TRUE, on_state = ...)`. Each callback receives the raw logits and selected activations that produced the sampled token, with explicit source positions. One outstanding state waits for acknowledgement before token delivery and the next decode.

The callback returns NULL to continue, or a partial `list(steer = data.frame(intervention, coef))` for existing steering entries. Updates are atomic, apply to the next decode and preserve historical KV. Worker-generated coefficient/revision/source metadata records what was applied. Zero clears a contribution; the original adapters are restored on completion, cancellation and failure. Directions, layers and ablations cannot be changed through this reply.

R callbacks run on the R thread. The context-owned hook, R/FFI boundary and Arrow spill path enforce explicit materialized-object, transient-copy, frame and disk limits. Model/KV/backend storage and user-retained objects are outside that transport ledger. No dependency, public export name, vendor patch or numerical tolerance changes. Independent state/history goldens precede the implementation in a separate commit.

## F6b validation

- Native: format/clippy/no-spill and 23 selected outcomes passed. The independent three-layer history oracle checked 3,360 values with unchanged bounds, plus reply/audit/zero/ownership/restoration cases, affected acknowledgements and seven FFI cases.
- Fresh installed R: 19 cases/551 expectations, including three actual cached-Qwen cases, no test skips or warnings. One initial fixture compared a correctly valued but named matrix scalar with an unnamed expected number; its captured parent failure is retained. The correction checks row names separately and exact numeric identity. Only that case was repeated, on the same installed binary; the other 18 retain their original source scope.
- Source build and scoped package check: zero errors, two deliberate omitted-rendered-vignette warnings. External duplicate-lc++ and testthat patch-version warnings are retained. All nine ordinary checks now pass at exact `490c7f4` (links below).
- Public measurements: 16 runs/2,048 delivered states, CPU and Metal handles, one warm-up plus three balanced pairs per backend. Worker audit, object bounds and seeded reset checks pass. Median callback-exit-to-next-state intervals: CPU 11ms/11ms, Metal handle 19ms/22ms for unchanged/changing coefficients. These include validation, acknowledgement, decode and R scheduling; they are not isolated setter cost or new offload evidence.
- One focused integrated F6b review completed. Its probe-peak and R-workspace findings were corrected and exercised. All earlier compile/fixture failures and exact source manifests are preserved.

**Operational acceptance complete:** actual foreground F6b steering passed on 2026-10-04 (details below), alongside the automated acceptance at `490c7f4`. This final milestone changes only documentation and retained evidence. Its own nine ordinary checks remain required before marking ready; merge consent is a separate boundary.

## Accepted F6a evidence retained at its original source

F6a is complete at `6877c4d`: native CPU/Metal feasibility, independent causal numerics, allocation/Arrow controls, fresh R 26 cases/860 expectations/seven cached-model cases, public latency and all-layer resource checks. Actual foreground RStudio ran 6.911s with 118 states, 117 delivered tokens, 119 heartbeats, an independent active `1 + 1` and exact cancellation; user workspace was restored. This capture-only demonstration does not substitute for F6b steering.

All nine F6a ordinary checks passed: [R CI](https://github.com/Vadale/R-ebirth/actions/runs/37142228825), [Rust CI](https://github.com/Vadale/R-ebirth/actions/runs/37142228867). The [15-case live-only sanitizer](https://github.com/Vadale/R-ebirth/actions/runs/37142257323) passed and its artifacts were independently verified: exact product JSON/raw hashes, 3,840-value marker, four declared Rust archives across three crates, 269 native compile/symbol receipts, seven callback negative controls, 68 layout cases, four mixed faults and uninstrumented rejection. Full object/archive/executable bytes are absent from artifacts: their digests remain runtime receipts; downloaded symbols, flags and test bytes were independently checked. Scope is exercised Linux CPU paths, not R/SEXP, GPU, vision, TSan or universal absence of undefined behavior.

The new sanitizer selection runs only ten F6b cases with the same production-library, Cargo-variant, instrumentation and negative-control audits; default full coverage becomes 40 cases. Accepted F6a and Valgrind evidence is not rerun.

See `docs/phase6-implementation.md`, `docs/phase6-memory-contract.md` and `tests/live-state/measurements/` for contracts, raw receipts and limitations. This is research instrumentation, not a validated detector or safety guarantee.


## Verified F6b Linux sanitizer at `490c7f4`

The [steering-only run37149145363](https://github.com/Vadale/R-ebirth/actions/runs/37149145363) passed. Its once-downloaded artifacts independently verify all ten exact named product libtest results and raw stdout/stderr hashes, including the3,360value history marker (maximum activation difference0.003543657, logit difference0.001758994; unchanged0.01bounds). The production library, all four declared Rust archives/Cargo variants,269native object compile/symbol receipts, seven callback runtime rejections,68layout cases, four mixed faults and uninstrumented rejection match their receipts. All37remote harness controls passed and all2,447source hashes matched the exact head.

The verified inventory has746files/45,790,743bytes; manifestSHA256 `a289ede4851997182420fe6a1e88890b71cfc9db8161e9a75426a7d792e0adb9`. Full native object/archive/test-binary bytes are absent: their hashes remain runtime receipts, while actual symbols, flags, source and per-test bytes were independently checked. Scope remains exercised Linux CPU paths, not R/SEXP, GPU, vision, TSan or a universal guarantee.

The initial [ordinary Rust attempt](https://github.com/Vadale/R-ebirth/actions/runs/37149081409/attempts/1) passed four jobs but failed its Linux engine job before fmt/clippy/tests: the sccache Linux binary download returned HTTP500 three times. Its raw logs and job/attempt records are retained. The one job-only retry passed on the unchanged head; the first failed attempt remains preserved. This establishes a download infrastructure failure, not a product failure or a general GitHub outage. All four R checks have now passed.


## Ordinary CI verified at runtime candidate `490c7f4`

All nine individual required checks are successful and the PR head matches
`490c7f41a417110d0109be01ce74d8e213e1ee46`: four [R checks](https://github.com/Vadale/R-ebirth/actions/runs/37149081421)
and five [Rust checks](https://github.com/Vadale/R-ebirth/actions/runs/37149081409).
The infrastructure-only failed Rust attempt is retained; no product/workflow
change or weakened gate was needed. The independently verified ten-case F6b
sanitizer above also passed at this head. This closes automated local and remote
acceptance, with each earlier receipt retaining its recorded source scope.

## Actual foreground steering passed on 2026-10-04

After the founder unlocked the Mac, the real RStudio Console ran the test in a fresh restarted session using the same F6b installed runtime (all 27 file hashes matched). Generation ran **20.190s**, submission **13ms**, with **346 states / 345 tokens, 21 coefficient revisions and 348 heartbeats**. A separately submitted `1 + 1` returned 2 while native work was active at state345/revision21, below R clock resolution and the 500ms gate. Cancellation at state346 prevented its token and the next state; seeded original-adapter reset passed.

Independent receipt verification checked every state/source/revision/coefficient and object bound (maximum44,664bytes within66,488). Its initial heterogeneous-frame character-matrix comparison was corrected to per-column numeric comparison; no inference was rerun, and both collector sources are retained. User globals/RNG/library/search paths and temporary environment values were restored and checked; editor documents were untouched. User workspace backups remain local and are excluded from the PR.

Evidence: `tests/live-state/measurements/rstudio-steering-2026-10-04`. The final operational milestone archives already verified sanitizer/CI evidence and updates the implementation report without changing runtime, workflows, dependencies, numerical inputs or bounds. Accepted local/model/RStudio/sanitizer work is not repeated; every result retains its executed source. Final evidence/documentation head `363529252e7d7b9d9e9cf1af39c2f1c77a9355ad` is pending its nine ordinary checks. Its runtime, workflows, sanitizer harness and numerical inputs exactly match `490c7f4`. After all nine checks pass, PR59 can be marked ready; specific squash-merge consent is still required.
